section_summary.extract_value: This introduction section presents a comprehensive literature review on cosmetic surgery attitudes, establishing the context for a single quantitative study conducted in Brazil. The study aims to examine the factor structure of the Acceptance of Cosmetic Surgery Scale (ACSS) and its correlates, including body appreciation (measured via the Body Appreciation Scale), media internalization, and self-reported BMI, filling a gap in non-Western research on cosmetic surgery attitudes.
